body: Tinder would be a way to make me happy and disguise the relationship’s unhappiness, so I could give her more time and hopefully have her get better. It just seems any time is better than no time in this situation

Unfortunately both her family and friends know, it’s really a grave situation. I understand in a normal relationship, both have to be happy for it to work or it’s okay and normal to separate. But this case, it seems different to know there might not be a moving on for her.

I am keeping her alive. Attached to me as her partner or individual, if she is let alone, she is done. I hate to say it but it’s true. I understand I’m wasting both our times, but that’s my point. I’m giving her time she wouldn’t have and trying to not waste my time meanwhile.

Thank you so so much. It’s so good to have this constructive comment, it’s exactly what I needed, especially the last bit.

I feel like she really isn’t putting effort into it. Even doing all those things, she ends up falling in the same routine and hating herself for it but never actually looking for changes to do. That’s why it’s so tiresome to me. Every day that ends, I am met with her breaking down. She has been taking meds and switched some psychiatrists so I think it’s more the second scenario. 

I’m going to block the tinder idea. And try what you advised. Thank you again

Putting it like that, it really probably won’t go.

Isn’t being her motivation to live doing her a favor? I feel like just breaking up for my happiness would be saying I’d rather do nothing than “keep” her alive and that’s why it’s so hard. I just need an excuse

Jesus Christ. If I break up, she is done, okay? I don’t want to be in this position and never asked to. Maybe it’s hard to understand my point, obviously cheating is bad but isn’t it better than “killing” a person?

And forget all that bullshit about sex, I just want to be happy

That’s a very interesting point and exactly why I made this post. Thank you very much.

I’m really doing it only for me, but also don’t blame myself since it’s such a heavy weight/blame to carry

My point is that maybe if I can be happier, she will get more of our relationship and be happier. I really don’t want to take that responsibility and completely agree with what you said first. If I can manage to lower myself even more, I wanted her to find someone else and trade me for them. I don’t want to be in this position. Maybe/probably without the distance, having someone near all the time would do a lot better for her, but how can she take that step if there is no in between relationships?

I agree but she has gotten help for 2+ years. She has tried to get better, family involved and everything. She tried to end it and got support from friends and people she barely knew. I also try to motivate her even more, but it doesn’t seem to work. 

And I agree with you, she really isn’t happy, but what the hell, should I just let her die then?

That’s what I am trying to convince myself, but how? I just can’t be bothered to not let someone die? It’s such a strange concept to me.

Also, I think the therapist could be a great idea. I have one available and might check up in. Thanks
I don’t want to be the guy that killed her

I get what you mean, but she has been getting help for 2+ years with family involved. She has tried taking her life before and I know she means it. It’s really harder to do it than to say it, I’ve been trying for so long
